subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error**:

The suddenness with which the issue escalated (1)/ took not only the negotiators but also the observers (2)/ by surprise who were expecting (3)/ a gradual resolution process. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '**3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The clause "**by surprise who were expecting**" is awkward and grammatically incorrect in placement.
 
• The relative pronoun "**who**" incorrectly appears to modify "**surprise**" instead of "**negotiators and observers**".
 
• The sentence should be restructured for proper meaning, such as: *"...took not only the negotiators but also the observers, who were expecting a gradual resolution process, by surprise."*
 
• Therefore, the error lies in **Part 3**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The suddenness with which the issue escalated took not only the negotiators but also the observers, **who were expecting**__ a gradual resolution process, by surprise."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• A relative clause should be placed close to the noun it modifies.
 
• Misplaced modifiers can create confusion in sentence meaning.
